name: Play Imposter Online
tagline: Play Imposter Online is a free multiplayer social deduction word game that runs directly in your browser
description: Play Imposter Online is a free multiplayer social deduction word game that runs directly in your browser. Players join a room, receive secret words, give clues, debate suspicious answers, and vote to find the imposter with the different word. It works well for parties, remote game nights, classrooms, family gatherings, Discord calls, and Zoom hangouts. The site supports online rooms, room codes, mobile play, customizable settings, curated word categories, and local Pass & Play mode on one device
